name: Regex Validator
description: Validate the syntax of a regular expression and report errors and suggestions.

hints.pattern: This tool only validates and never matches, so it accepts no subject text and cannot time out.
hints.output: A valid pattern reports the capture group count and suggestions; an invalid one reports the exact position.

faq.a: The RE2 flavour (Go regular expressions) is used throughout; backreferences and recursion are not supported.

faq.q: How does this differ from the regex tester?
faq.a: The regex tester actually matches text and lists every hit; this tool only judges whether the expression itself is valid.
